cms.permissionExplanation: EmDash checks both token scopes and the account role. A Contributor (role 20) can create content and edit owned drafts, but cannot publish even its own draft; publishing remains an editorial action for a suitably authorized account. Draft read visibility is broader than edit ownership and does not imply permission to edit another author's draft. The live schema read was denied because this token lacks schema:read; content-authoring permission does not grant schema access or schema administration. The checked-in role guide assigns schema/configuration administration to Admin. No scopes, roles, settings or schema were changed, and publication denial was explained from the documented role contract rather than tested with a publish attempt.
